x_required_semantic_checks: Only controller assigns seq after persistence; relay cannot renumber
Evidence IDs must exist in same meeting
Authenticated owner matches intervention; expected_revision matches
Speak requires valid confirmed intervention and current safe pause
Configured device limits and capabilities override generic schema ranges
Same command_id is idempotent; boot_id change invalidates automatic retry
ttl_ms uses local monotonic timer; server does not send expired work
Only authenticated device/host playback callback may record receipts
No unconfirmed candidate is summarized as an agreed decision
Repair orient/light is also bound to confirmed intervention; only preapproved status light and safe stop may be independent
All device TTS audio streams are bound to current confirmed command_id; remote human voice is a distinct non-AI-media purpose
Device completed receipt requires actual playback queue drain; host_speaker_test must not impersonate robot_audio
LiveKit track identity and device stream_key map to server-authorized member/meeting; no self-subscription feedback
Audio consent, visible recording indicator and raw audio retention defaults are enforced outside JSON Schema

x_http_routes.request_schema: multipart image/jpeg with meeting binding; server creates Capture and validates size/type; no arbitrary remote URL

x_http_routes.response: 200 paired identity/capabilities; boot change invalidates retry
202 prioritized stop; global stop only local operator
202 accepted; later RobotReceipt to controller; unsupported action rejected

x_http_routes.request_schema: EmptyRequest for POST; GET returns Summary

x_http_routes.response: 200 server-generated room binding, identity, short-lived scoped credential; never token in URL

x_transport_notes.audio: Normalized device and ASR input: 16kHz mono s16le. Device binary stream follows x_media_contract; authorized public room uses WebRTC media, never base64 event audio.
x_transport_notes.remote_browser: HTTPS REST + WSS with authenticated same-origin session, Origin check; no token in URL
x_transport_notes.site_gateway: outbound WSS with gateway credential, canonical seq kept unchanged
x_transport_notes.device: Paired same-Wi-Fi isolated bench can use authenticated HTTP/WS. First product requires trusted TLS or signed command/control envelopes and protected pairing; safety stop remains local.
x_transport_notes.retry: command_id stays unchanged; boot_id change invalidates auto retry; accepted receipt is not completion
x_transport_notes.fixture_safety: all mock; replay defaults to no real hardware side effects
x_transport_notes.device_pairing: Private target addresses are configured in pair table; DeviceHello cannot inject arbitrary callback URLs
x_transport_notes.capture: On-demand device JPEG -> authorized multipart Capture endpoint; paired_capture_device bound to meeting, size/type validated and frame buffer released; no continuous video required.

contest_prototype.capture: onboard microphone/ADC via I2S and AFE
contest_prototype.compute: team-maintained PC for local ASR/controller; cloud understanding

x_media_contract.device_endpoint: /device/v1/audio on paired local gateway; robot initiates WS/WSS connection
x_media_contract.control: Authenticated UTF-8 JSON AudioStreamConfig -> AudioStreamReady matching session_id/stream_key (accepted true before binary frames) -> AudioStreamEnd after final payload; media examples are synthetic.

binary_frame.payload: sample_count * 2 bytes, s16le mono at 16000Hz; typical 20ms/320 samples/640 bytes

stream_rules: stream_key is unique within authenticated session; identity/meeting/stream mapping is from server pairing
packet_seq and sample_start start at 0; advance by 1 and sample_count respectively; 32-bit limits require new session before wrap
audio.start -> matching audio.ready -> binary frames -> audio.end; reconnect creates new session and does not replay old TTS
ordered WS frames; reject malformed/wrong-session frames, repeated packet ignored; gap becomes silence/diagnostic, not replay of stale speech
20ms frames, playback queue bounded to 200ms as an initial test parameter; overflow aborts TTS with failed receipt and starts clean session, never unbounded accumulation
remote_voice is human conversation; robot_tts requires current confirmed RobotCommand and matching command_id before any playback

audio.end or sender completion is not RobotReceipt.completed; device must drain actual playback queue, then issue completed receipt; stop cancels queued TTS, AudioStreamEnd.reason=stopped and RobotReceipt.status=failed/error_code=CANCELLED
playback sample stream used as AEC reference with board-specific alignment; AFE raw multichannel input not assumed identical to normalized wire PCM
x_media_contract.remote_media: LiveKit WebRTC; remote track bound to authorized meeting member; onsite published track not resubscribed and fed back as remote input
x_media_contract.privacy: Media crosses public service for consented voice meeting; event relay never stores/base64 embeds raw PCM; default no raw audio retention; transcript/image retention and model processing separately disclosed
